about: Titagarh Rail Systems Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of freight and passenger rail systems in India and internationally. The company offers forged wheel set, loco shells, couplers, draft gears, cast bogies, and cast manganese steel crossing products; automobile-carrying, flat, hopper, tank, box, covered, and special purpose wagons; and brake vans.
